context: Prefer a general fix over another one-off path: make codespell honor .gitignore (or drive it from `git ls-files`) so the next gitignored directory does not need a third patch. If that is not workable, add @~ to the --skip list at Makefile:947 and say why the general fix was rejected.
description: Second instance of the defect class fixed for node_modules by #1348. .gitignore:72 ignores `@~/`, but the codespell invocation at Makefile:947 has no matching --skip entry, so `make spellcheck` scans ./@~/benchbox/*.dss and exits 65 in /Users/joe/Developer/BenchBox (observed 2026-07-30: psuedo, whithout, auxillaries x2, setence and more). This makes `make pr-preflight` fail for anyone working in the primary clone. It is invisible to CI and to pool worktrees because @~/ is a main-clone-only stray directory, which is exactly why it has gone unnoticed. Promoted from deferral #670 on spellcheck-node-modules-skip-never-landed-v2.

preserves.behavior: Real source-tree typos are still caught; --ignore-words behaviour unchanged
The node_modules skip added by #1348 keeps working

verifications.command: mkdir -p "@~/benchbox" && printf "recieve teh occured\n" > "@~/benchbox/probe.dss" && make spellcheck; rc=$?; rm -rf "@~"; exit $rc
verifications.description: spellcheck passes with a gitignored @~/ directory present

verifications.command: mkdir -p results-explorer/node_modules/pkg && printf "recieve teh occured\n" > results-explorer/node_modules/pkg/index.js && make spellcheck; rc=$?; rm -rf results-explorer/node_modules; exit $rc
verifications.description: the node_modules skip from #1348 is not regressed

work_units.evidence: Reproduced in the primary clone: make spellcheck exits 65 on TWO gitignored paths, not one -- ./@~/benchbox/dists.dss (.gitignore:72) and ./results-explorer/dist/assets/index-BIHIG_7T.js (results-explorer/.gitignore:2). Neither directory exists in a fresh pool worktree, where the gate is green; that asymmetry is the whole defect.

Chose the general fix over adding @~ by name: the narrow option would still leave the gate red on results-explorer/dist/, and more gitignored dirs exist (.codex/, .gemini/, .todo-db/). spellcheck now scans the TRACKED file list (git ls-files) so no gitignored path can ever be scanned. Proof in pool-06: rung 1 exit 0, rung 2 exit 0, results-explorer/dist/ fixture exit 0, and a planted typo in the tracked benchbox/utils/clock.py still fails the gate (exit 2, 3 hits) so must-preserve holds.
work_units.summary: Make the gate skip gitignored paths generally, or add @~ with a recorded rationale
